digest.component_or_area: LLM Bedrock region configuration and provenance
propositions: Region provenance records currently mislabel config-file regions as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION instead of repo-config due to loss of origin metadata during CLI/env/config resolution.
LLMConfig.from_env collapses bedrock_region_name resolution via _llm_str, discarding the value's source; resolve_bedrock_region then labels all configured values identically regardless of origin.
Region source labeling must be derived from the same single resolution pass that produces the value and carried through LLMConfig to provenance_for, preventing record/runtime divergence.
Resolution precedence (CLI > REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > config-file > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION) must remain unchanged; only the region_source label varies by origin.
Provider provenance must truthfully record region origin as repo-config, cli, REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, or AWS_REGION according to which source won resolution.
